historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr, cross-checked against FY2026 revenue guidance of 3-4%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (4.6%) is less than half the revenue 5yr CAGR (10.3%): equity is suppressed by $2.2bn of buybacks FY21-25, and the 5yr revenue CAGR starts from COVID-hit FY2020. Revenue has been flat at $3.7-4.1bn since FY2021, which is the more honest anchor.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - withholding taxes - interest income): FY2020 ~348, FY2022 85.3, FY2023 414, FY2024 401, FY2025 268.5. The 46.6% 3yr owner-FCF CAGR is a base effect off the FY2022 working-capital trough and is not a growth rate. EPS 5yr CAGR is omitted: FY2020 EPS of $22.41 contains a ~$1.4bn tax benefit from an IP intra-entity transfer. SBC has grown faster than revenue (FY22 3.6% -> FY25 4.6% of revenue), so an increasing share of reported FCF is paid for in stock.

scenario_narratives.base: Align delivers its FY2026 guide (revenue +3-4%, case volume +6%, Systems & Services -6-8%) and then grows mid-single digits: the Clear Aligner franchise keeps compounding volume internationally and in teens/DSOs, partly offset by ASP mix pressure and a structurally smaller scanner line. Adjusted EBITDA margin rebuilds from a one-off-laden 22.5% in FY2026 to ~26% by FY2029, consistent with management's +100bp/yr non-GAAP operating-margin targets for FY26-27, but not back to the ~29-30% peak of FY2019/FY2021 because price competition caps it. Owner FCF margin ~12-13% at maturity.
scenario_narratives.bull: The category re-accelerates: clear aligners resume taking share from wires and brackets in under-penetrated APAC and EMEA, Invisalign First and DSO penetration broaden the market, and AI ClinCheck plus DSP/pay-per-scan subscriptions turn the iTero base back into a growth funnel. The operating-model review removes structural cost, and margins return to the prior-cycle ~29% adj EBITDA. Revenue grows 7-8% at the peak before fading to 3.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Align's pricing power erodes: lower-cost competitors (Envista Spark, Straumann ClearCorrect, Angelalign) take the value tier as core patents lapse, North America adult retail stays soft with discretionary self-pay patients deferring treatment under high financing rates, and iTero capital-equipment demand does not recover. Align defends volume with price, so revenue grows ~2% and adjusted EBITDA margin slides to ~21.5%; recurring restructuring and jurisdictional tax hits (UK VAT) become a feature, not one-offs.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Align is valued as a mature, cash-generative category leader whose growth algorithm has broken: the model does not credit a return to the historical 15-20% growth, charges SBC and equity-award withholding taxes as real costs, strips interest on the $1.1bn cash pile, and rebuilds margins from components rather than carrying FY2025's restructuring-depressed or H1-26's deferred-revenue-flattered cash flow forward.
key_risks_to_valuation: Share loss at the value tier to Spark, ClearCorrect and Chinese aligners as patents lapse -- the bear margin path
North America discretionary demand and patient-financing rates
Deferred revenue has fallen ~$240m from the FY2023 peak; if the unwind persists beyond FY2027 the base FCF is overstated by ~$50-70m/yr
Recurring 'one-time' charges (restructuring every year since FY2022, UK VAT) -- the base keeps ~0.5pp of margin for them
Operating-model review outcome: upside (cost reset) or a strategic change that alters the capital-return story
Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF in base; the valuation is sensitive to WACC given an equity-only capital structure

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 122.00-200.44
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 1097149) and ALGN_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, millions USD): FY2025 10-K; Q1-26 and Q2-26 10-Qs for cash (2026-06-30), shares on issue (2026-07-31 cover), SBC, withholding taxes, interest income, lease liabilities
data_sources.qualitative: ALGN_Analysis.json (2026-09-25), incl. Q2-2026 earnings release guidance of 2026-08-06

inputs.share_count_basis: 71.04m shares on issue at 2026-07-31 (Q2-26 10-Q cover) plus ~0.03m treasury-method dilution (Q2-26 diluted 71.520m vs basic 71.495m). Held FLAT: SBC plus equity-award withholding taxes are fully expensed in the flows, so diluting as well would double-count. Align is a funded repurchaser ($466m FY25, $98m H1-26, $400-500m planned FY26), so the flat count is paid for in cash.
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL FY2025 10-K: ShareBasedCompensation 185.87 (cash-flow add-back) + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation 20.39 (financing). Align publishes no combined reconciliation figure, so the two lines are summed. TTM to Q2-26: 179.1 + 29.7 = 208.8 (5.0% of TTM revenue 4,139.5).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. 10-year UST ~4.3% + beta ~1.15 x 5.0% ERP = ~10.0%. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Observed 5y beta (~1.6-1.7) is inflated by the 2021-22 bubble-and-bust; 1.15 reflects a discretionary-consumer medical device with an 80%+ category share. One WACC across all scenarios -- risk is carried in the bear flows and a 25% bear weight, not a premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases (liabilities $120.8m at 2026-06-30; lease cost ~$43m/yr) are expensed inside operating income and therefore inside EBITDA; lease liabilities are NOT in net debt. One treatment, charged once. No finance leases outstanding.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (routing row 1: operating company, medical device / consumer-healthcare with a software-and-scanner ecosystem). No prior valuation or memory entry. OWNER FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 490.8 - SBC incl. withholding taxes 206.3 - interest income 16.1 = 268.5 (6.7% margin). FY2025 is a trough: $43m restructuring accrual, $23m impairment, and a ~$70m deferred-revenue unwind (1,331.2 -> 1,261.8). TTM to Q2-26 owner FCF is ~408 (9.9%), FY2023-24 ~400-414 (10-11%). INTEREST INCOME stripped (FY25 $16.1m, H1-26 $8.6m) because net cash ($1.10bn) is >1x the owner-FCF base. EBITDA MARGIN is pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA: FY25 GAAP EBITDA 783.2 + SBC 185.9 = 969 (24.0%) with restructuring/impairment still inside; FY26 guide is non-GAAP op margin ~23% (+100bp) and a further ~100bp in FY27, i.e. clean adj EBITDA ~26.5%. The base path starts BELOW that (22.5% FY26) to absorb the $90-100m FY26 one-offs (incl. $37.5m UK VAT) plus the continuing deferred-revenue unwind (-$75m in H1-26), which the engine's growth-linked working-capital line cannot carry; restructuring has recurred every year since FY22, so the mature base margin (26%) keeps ~0.5pp of it as a recurring cost. D&A 3.8% of revenue (Q2-26 run-rate; FY25's 5.9% was inflated by accelerated depreciation on restructured sites). Capex 3.0% (FY24 2.9%, FY25 2.5%, TTM 2.9%). Cash tax 24% on EBIT (FY25 cash tax paid $134.8m; GAAP ETR 25.7% H1-26 incl. non-deductible SBC; Pillar Two floor). Working capital: receivables ~25% of revenue exceed payables and deferred revenue is shrinking, so growth consumes cash: wc_capture -10% of the revenue increase. Cash and share count are at 2026-06-30 / 2026-07-31 while FY2026 is projected in full: the H1-26 owner FCF overlap (~$150m, ~$2/share) is roughly offset by the $98m H1-26 buybacks that already shrank the count; noted, not adjusted.

bear.narrative: Expired patents let Spark, ClearCorrect and Chinese makers (Angelalign) take the value end; North America adult retail stays soft under higher financing costs; iTero keeps shrinking; Align defends volume with price (no-AA, lower-priced packages) so revenue barely grows and adj EBITDA drifts to ~21.5% while SBC stays elevated to retain talent.

base.narrative: Guide-anchored FY26 (+3.5%), then mid-single-digit growth as international and teen volumes (+6% case volume) outrun a flat North America adult retail market and a shrinking scanner line; margin rebuilds to ~26% adj EBITDA (non-GAAP op margin ~24%) as one-offs and the deferred-revenue unwind roll off.

bull.narrative: Clear aligners resume share-taking from wires and brackets: APAC/EMEA double-digit volume, teen/growing-patient and DSO channels, AI ClinCheck and DSP scanner subscriptions widen the funnel; the operating-model review and new directors take out cost, returning adj EBITDA to the 29% of FY2019/FY2021.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: revenue has been flat at $3.7-4.1bn for five years, core patents have lapsed, North America demand is soft and the board has launched an operating-model review, so the share-erosion path is live. Base 50%: it is the company's own guide extended at the category's growth rate. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs a volume re-acceleration, ASP stability and a cost reset to all go right after four years without growth. Balance sheet risk is nil (no debt, $1.1bn cash), which is why bear is not higher.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
